reddit.title: Bunko: classics with pinyin and furigana
reddit.content:
I built Bunko: Classics with Ruby to keep a book's original text in view while checking a translation.

For example, the Daodejing can show Classical Chinese, modern Chinese and English, sentence by sentence, with modern Mandarin pinyin above the characters. Japanese editions have furigana. You choose which language layers to show, rather than replacing the original with a translation.

Downloaded books stay readable offline. These are unadapted classics, not graded beginner stories; the AI-assisted study translations can contain mistakes. The offline reading library doesn't require an account.

It's available on Google Play, US$0.99 once for the app:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=art.lazying.bunko
